title: Route Engram's test launcher through the shared `engram source` reader instead of its own index listing
outcome: Route Engram's test launcher through the shared `engram source` reader instead of its own index listing
acceptance: scripts/review-freeze-fingerprint.mjs captureCommitInputStatus no longer runs `git ls-files --stage` or `git ls-files -v` and no longer refuses submodule gitlinks; every launcher committed-input capture and admission point calls the shared owner through the bounded adapter.

The shared real-Git fixture table proves the launcher reaches the owner's verdicts (clean, not clean, unavailable) on clean, dirty, untracked, off-pin, uninitialized, filter-configured, nested and missing-mapping repositories.

Owner binary selection (default $CARGO_HOME/bin/engram, absolute ENGRAM_SOURCE_BINARY override, no PATH or autobuild), unavailable-never-plain handling, and the run-directory lookup that keeps the caller's GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES while isolating GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE behave as designed, with launcher tests covering each.

completion.summary: Landed and installed d30a4a06. The exact candidate's FULL passed 12/12 stages and 3/3 preflights with unchanged fingerprints; Codex/Claude latest review round had no Medium+ and its Low was filed independently. Central release build succeeded, all six stores were ready before and after install on the new build fingerprint, and the previous installed executable was retained as backup.
